item.title: 0.1.7 Beta 11
item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.7-Beta-11
# SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 11 for macOS 26 (unofficial port)
Upstream Beta 11, ported to build and run on macOS 26.5 (Xcode 26.6 / Swift 6.3). Still includes PR #528 (Rich Presence by DinanathDash).
## From upstream Beta 11
- Profile bios now show Discord Markdown, spoilers, code, custom emoji and live timestamps - `:name:` emoji shortcodes, with aliases, skin tones and jumbo emoji - Embeds use Discord's own sizes and spacing, and their titles show Markdown and custom emoji - Server profiles show when someone joined the server - Voice encryption keeps working when someone leaves a call and rejoins (libdave 1.3.0) - Role mentions stay highlighted after you send them, and tall images no longer show dark lines - Removed Show hidden channels, since Discord now sends channels you can't view as nameless placeholders
## Port changes
- Rich Presence (PR #528) updated to the PR's latest version - Updates still use Sparkle 2.9.6 (upstream switched to its own Sparkle build) - Swift 6.3 fixes for the new embed layout
**Upstream changelog:** https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-10...v0.1.7-Beta-11
